@tct.chat-composer.pastedText.defaultMessage: {lines, plural, one {{chars, plural, one {# char} other {# chars}}} other {# lines, {chars, plural, one {# char} other {# chars}}}}
@tct.chat-composer.pastedText.description: Label of the chip that stands for a long pasted text in the chat composer: how many lines and characters it holds. `{lines}` is the number of lines and `{chars}` the number of characters. A single line reads `812 chars`; several read `3 lines, 812 chars`. Also the chip's accessible name.

@tct.chat-composer.noResults.description: Text in the suggestion popup of the chat composer when a trigger character (`@`, `/`) matched nothing. Short, neutral.

@tct.chat-composer.searching.description: Text in the suggestion popup of the chat composer while an asynchronous search is running. Present progressive; the trailing `…` is one character.
